reviews.text: After many years, I can't say I'm a happy customer

This is the only place I will ever take my fur babies to and have for over 10 years. You all have been like family and how much you have taken care of Miley and Xena means the absolute world to me. I recommend this team to multiple people because the love, trust, and confidence I have in this team I can testify to it all. Even when Miley passed away when Xena and I felt broke you helped bring comfort to us that impacted us in such a way to help us move forward. Thank you all so very much for everything you do and I will always return because as I’ve said you all have become family to us. I couldn’t have been blessed with a better team. I am eternally grateful!!!

Staff very friendly and the vet doc was very concerned about what was going on with my baby boy she explained to me in the way I could understand they are reasonable in the cost of what he had to have done to him I really liked every one there I would recommend this vet to everyone who ever needs to take the pet to a veterinary clinic
Thank you every one that works works there
Love coming here.  Entire staff make us feel like family.  And we love the way they treat our dog as if she is their own.

My dog loves the kind and caring folks at westridge and they’re the only place we’ll take him to get his nails done! The staff are so kind and caring and I always feel comfortable knowing my dog is getting the care he deserves!

We love taking our Luna to Westridge Animal Hospital. She is a very anxious nervous 6 year old Yorkie and they have so much patience with her. Dr Todd is the best!! Thank you so much for taking care of our wild child!

I recently needed to find a new vet. My sister recommended them to me & I'm so happy I took my two little dogs there! Every single person I came into contact with was kind, gentle with my pet & able to answer all my questions. I have one dog that you might call special needs & everyone at the vets office really went above & beyond to make my dog feel safe & relaxed. I could drone on but bottom line is they're a great veterinarian practice.

I truely appreciate the care you gave to Charlie.  Was so nice to have a personal touch from the whole team.  Dr. Todd calling with updates throughout was absolutely amazing!  It is so rare to have this level of communication.   Thank you !
Great care provided to my pet.
Thanks for the review, Dennis! Our team appreciates it.

I've been bringing my dog here 6 years now, it's about time I wrote a review! Where to start? The staff, all of them are lovely. Shout out to Michelle, Christina, Dr. Scott (happy retirement Dr. Peterson!) everyone who's names idk, you are awesome!! We just met Dr. Gabby and she's so nice we want her to be our vet forever!
My dog can be a little stinker and everyone is patient and kind. I really appreciate the vibe cause vet visits aren't everyday and the staff is very understanding.
Side Note: The building itself is so cool! It's all browns and wood, very natural and they even have a bird atrium attachment!

It’s hard to put into words what someone like Dr. Peterson means to the people and animals he’s helped over the last 40+ years.

In a world where so many people feel rushed, overlooked, or treated like just another number, he was different. He was honest, straightforward, compassionate, and real. He treated people with respect and understood that families go through hard times and don’t always have unlimited money. That kind of understanding and integrity is rare today.

He never came across as someone trying to upsell people or push unnecessary treatments. You could tell he genuinely cared about the animals and the families who loved them. That’s what made him stand out, and honestly, that’s what every veterinarian should strive to be.

He built trust through decades of consistency, humility, and doing right by people. There are not many professionals left who carry themselves the way he did.

I truly wish I could have seen him one last time before his retirement to personally thank him for everything he’s done over the years. He made a lasting impact on so many lives, including mine.

I hope the veterinarians and staff at Westridge Animal Hospital continue to follow the example he set, because his approach to caring for both animals and people is something special and worth carrying forward.

Thank you for over four decades of dedication, compassion, honesty, and service to the community. Wishing you nothing but peace, happiness, good health, and an amazing retirement. You earned it.
Best wishes to Dr. Petersen on the occasion of his retirement.
Thanks for the review, Alicia! Our team appreciates it.
My pup passed away over 16 years old
Thanks for the review, Jeff! Our team appreciates it.

Never take your animals here if you are if need of services or just may happen to be down on your luck but still have a family member who's a pet and still need help these people turned my puppy German shepard away because I didn't have the money to pay for services not even wanting to even look her over God for bid hospitals are like this such a disgrace on this place and everyone who works there
Thank you so much for the 5-star review, Amanda. We're glad you had a great experience with us!
The staff is nice.

I love my vet!!  I have been going to the Westridge Animal Hospital for about 18 years.  I go because the staff is competent and caring and my pets get fabulous care.  The location is not convenient for me, but quality care wins out.  The team at the Westridge Animal Hospital are terrific and I know my pets get the best care possible.
Very friendly staff and the vegetarians are informative, knowledgeable and caring.   It is  somewhat pricey but the health of our pets make worth it.

I've bring all my pets here, from my 70 pound pitbull to my abandoned 1 week old kittens and no matter what the issue, Dr. Petersen and his staff take their time with you and your pet! They actually explain things, give you information, give you food for thought, show you how to correctly do things for your pet and treat you like an equal!! I've NEVER felt rushed or like I was asking stupid questions. They definitely make you feel seen and heard!
I just love you guys!!!!!
Nice facility, nice people!  They get you right in and the prices are VERY reasonable.  They helped my daughter's dog get through parvo and he's doing great.  Thanks, Westridge!
Great experience and caring staff.
I bring my cats here. Dr. Quintana and Dr. Luttgeharm are both very nice and do a really great job!
Thank you for the 5 stars!
Thank you for the 5 stars! We love caring for your pets!
I've been taking our dogs to Westridge for years. I respect, trust and enjoy the staff. They strive to keep our pets healthy and happy!
I have been going to Westridge Animal Hospital for nearly 25 years, and they are the best!  They love our pets as much as we do.
We appreciate you taking the time to leave this review! 😊 …

Everyone is kind and patient with me and my dogs. I've used this vet center for over 20 years. They never had tried to upsell me on unnecessary tests and procedures. They have a very common sense take on veterinary care.
We have used Westridge Animal Hospital since 1984.  Dr. Peterson and staff are the best!!

I have been a "fan" of Dr, Pederson since the 80's. He has always exhibited professionalism AND compassion to my many feline friends. This attitude also extends to his fellow Veterinarians, Technicians and Office Staff of Westridge Animal Hospital,
Took our baby for a check up good place

Dr. Petersen has been our vet thru the joys being pet parents to countless furry family members for 40 years. We've always trusted the advice, treatment, care, and follow-up given to keep them all healthy and happy their entire lives. We wouldn't think of taking them anywhere else. Current love of our lives is a goofy golden retriever. (Is there any other kind?) Quite the handful when she'd rather play instead of having her temperature taken!
The staff are amazing. Everyone there cares about animals. My family has been bringing pets there for almost 50 years. I wouldn't go anywhere else

Been taking our fur babies there since we've been in Az. They take great care of our girl Jacki Bleu and always get me right in when I feel nervous about something that is going on with her. DR. Todd is great with her.
Amazing experience, Dr. Todd listened and explained our course of action for my fur baby! Truly recommend!

My pets, (dog and cat) have received excellent care at Westridge.  The staff knows both my pets and are received warmly.  Their diagnoses were spot on and the correct care and meds were dosed allowing my pets to recoop quickly and return to normal.
It's a place where animals can get better. Even if it takes time.
Very professional friendly and caring. Has my utmost respect. Thank you
THE BEST EVER
Always a great experience!
They are always so friendly and my dogs love going.

We had just moved into the area and we were in need to have our dog,  Luca, euthanized (she had cancer). Found Westridge animal hospital via Google.  The Dr and whole staff were so very compassionate to our situation. Big hugs to you all for making this very saddened moment as easy as possible.

Great service, really professional doctor, but I am not happy because they never asked me if I want wanted them to make a blood work to my dog, maybe was necessary but they never told me until I had to pay for it, I am not happy about it.
Thanks so much for the review, Sun!

West Ridge Animal Hospital has been nothing short of amazing since the first time I brought my boy Diesel in. From the welcoming staff to the attentive and caring doctors, every experience has been beyond positive.

The team here is incredibly thorough when explaining diagnoses, treatment plans, and next steps. They’re upfront, transparent, and always make sure you understand everything. I never felt rushed or left in the dark about Diesel’s care.

Even at the most difficult time—when it was Diesel’s end of life—the staff went above and beyond to provide comfort and compassion. They treated us with such kindness and care that it truly made a heartbreaking moment a little easier to bear.

I’m so grateful for the West Ridge team and the incredible love and respect they show for both pets and their families. I highly recommend them to anyone seeking a caring and professional veterinary practice.
Always takes the time to listen to our concerns. Explains in terms that I can understand and lays out the path for any medical treatments needed
They are incredible. Very professional

I have been going here since 1980 with all my dogs. I love the doctor. He sold his practice to a company a while ago, but I have not noticed any difference in service. I can't comment on cost as Westridge is the only vet I have gone to since moving to Arizona, but I will go there at least as long as Dr. Peterson is there.
Thanks for the vote of confidence! Your feedback means a lot to us, Drew!
Great place to take your pet, friendly kind service and fairly reasonable prices.
Have been using them for 15 years. Always friendly compassionate care and fair charges. Would recommend them.

Never got back to me. I'm in desperate need of getting the pit I inherited neutered and I'm looking for a place that will do free or discounted neuter for my dog. I emailed and called and left a message. I was told they would get back to me but nobody ever did.
I have used Dr. Peterson for years. I won't go anywhere else.
Very compassionate, great staff, wonderful doctor.

I have been with Dr Petterson for over 40 years. I remember when he was on Indian school Road he’s always treated our pets with loving care and went back to him after we moved because they weren’t happy with our other vets so our child …
The staff was super nice and helpful! I took my six year old yorkie/mix and they handled her with such kindness and patience. Their prices were also affordable for her medicine and care.
